summary: Visual graphic placeholders prevent blank sections while real Rosie-owned photos are gathered. They are CSS/JS safe, reduced-motion friendly, and should be replaced by approved R2 media as soon as available.

placeholder_slots.label: Service image placeholder
placeholder_slots.where: service cards, package cards, add-on cards
placeholder_slots.replace_with: service-specific vehicle/detailing photo or approved before/after crop

placeholder_slots.label: Town/local proof placeholder
placeholder_slots.where: town landing cards and local SEO proof sections
placeholder_slots.replace_with: customer-approved local proof image for the town/service

placeholder_slots.label: Before/after placeholder
placeholder_slots.where: gallery rows with missing before or after image

placeholder_slots.label: Seasonal campaign graphic placeholder
placeholder_slots.replace_with: campaign-specific graphic: spring salt, summer road trip, winter protection

placeholder_slots.label: Fleet/commercial placeholder
placeholder_slots.where: fleet mini-CRM and fleet public cards

placeholder_slots.label: Incident/evidence placeholder
placeholder_slots.where: incident reports and customer progress when evidence is pending or private

placeholder_slots.label: Review/testimonial placeholder
placeholder_slots.where: review proof cards and local trust blocks
placeholder_slots.replace_with: approved public review screenshot or typed testimonial

rules: Never expose private incident/report photos as placeholders or fallback images.
Public gallery placeholders must clearly say image is pending/repair needed so customers are not misled.
Every real image should have descriptive local alt text when used on public pages.
Use placeholders as temporary polish only; the Media Health and Gallery Approval screens should keep pushing toward real owned images.
desktop_mobile_notes: Placeholders use fluid aspect ratios and single-column mobile behavior.
Hover lift is disabled for reduced-motion users.
Cards remain visible without relying on a successful remote image load.
